card.name: Digits inside years in citations
card.fires_on: Mainly a single digit in the middle of a four-digit publication year or volume number inside a journal reference, such as the 7 in 1977 or the 0 in 2003. Weaker firing on mg or a after a dose number.

modes.label: Year digits in references
modes.description: A digit partway through a year or volume number in a journal citation.

modes.label: Dose wording
modes.description: Weaker firing on mg or a in dosing phrases.
